?Neutral Citation No. - 2025:Ahc-Lko:26993
Court No. - 30
Case :- Application U/S 483 No. - 366 of 2025
Applicant :- Smt. X (Victim Case Crime No. 167/2015)

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru.

Counsel for Applicant :- Prem Shanker Pandey,Abhishek Pandey Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Om Prakash Shukla,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

The present application has been filed with limited prayer for a direction to the concerned authority/court to conclude the trial of SST No.99/2021 arising out of Case Crime No.167/2015,
under Sections 376-D, 504, 506 I.P.C. and Section 3(2)(5) of S.C./S.T. Act, Police Station Ashiwan,
Now Behta Muzawar, District Unnao within stipulated time.

In view of the aforesaid, the concerned authority/court is directed to get the aforesaid case concluded with utmost expedition from the date a certified copy of this order is produced before it,
without granting any unnecessary adjournments to either of the parties, in case there is no other legal impediment.
With the aforesaid observation/direction the application is disposed of.
